seat: A person with a time limit to meet under a Victorian Act or statutory rule, asking on which day the period ends, whether the starting day counts, what a weekend or public holiday does to the last day, when the Act or rule took effect or stops having effect, and how a posted document is treated.
edition: Version No. 134, incorporating amendments as at 1 May 2026, from a plain-text conversion of the Word file published on the Victorian Legislation website; the conversion is not the official text and not an authorised version.

scope.encoded: The whole text as printed: Parts I to VI and Schedule 1, the 135 definition rows of ss 3, 38 to 38E, 60 and 64B(1), the time rules (ss 11, 12, 24, 25, 44, 49 and every date the text states), a provision index of 118 entries, and 212 cross-reference rows. Fourteen seat questions with 60 worked-case assertions.
scope.not_encoded_as_a_computed_answer: Periods of weeks and periods expressed with 'after' or 'before' a day; periods of months or years whose two readings give different days; facts the text takes from other instruments (public holidays, standard time, the commencement of other Acts), which are inputs. Machinery that affects no one now (the short title, the saving in s 41(4), the transitional provision in s 59, the regulation-making power in s 65, the Minister's power to make guidelines in s 38O(1)) is inert.
